Day 12, around a campfire near Highest point. Ben said "Scout" and everyone laughed. I didn't get the joke, but it stuck.
Day 10, around a campfire near mile 160. A section hiker whose name I never got said "Smokey" and everyone laughed. I didn't get the joke, but it stuck.
Day 24, around a campfire near Záruby. Martin said "Thunder" and everyone laughed. I didn't get the joke, but it stuck.
In Dobšiná, on my 4th zero, I ordered so much food the waitress asked if anyone was joining me. A section hiker whose name I never got has called me "Nachos" ever since.
I know everyone: water caches, trail magic, hiker boxes. Near Kojšovská hoľa, a section hiker whose name I never got said I'd hugged more people than I'd hiked miles. "Mayor" it is.
Near mile 160 I followed a cow path for two miles before noticing the trail was gone. Jakub found me and has called me "Lost & Found" since.
